routes.name: Visa on Arrival (online approval)
routes.summary: Apply online first, then get your visa at Roberts International Airport. Officers set a 30 or 90 day stay. Single entry. If Liberia has an embassy in your country, apply there instead.

other: Passport valid 6+ months. Arrive by air at Roberts International Airport.
Approval is valid for entry within 3 months.

documents: Printed or mobile approval PDF with QR code

routes.name: Regular visa (embassy)
routes.summary: Apply at a Liberian embassy. Regular processing at the US embassy is about 12 working days. A yellow fever immunization certificate is required.

other: Passport valid 6+ months, passport photo, yellow book.
Base fee and visa validity not listed on the page.

routes.processing: Regular processing 12 working days at the embassy in the US; same-day and next-day options cost extra.

routes.name: ECOWAS passport holders, no visa
routes.summary: Holders of ECOWAS passports do not need a visa for Liberia, per the Liberian embassy.

other: Length of stay and residence rights not confirmed on an official page.

routes.name: Naturalization
routes.summary: Apply to the Commissioner through a lawyer with a resident permit copy, police clearance, health certificate, four recommendation letters from prominent Liberians, and an autobiography. Marriage certificate if married to a Liberian.

other: Residence years, dual citizenship rules and eligibility restrictions were not on the page. Check with Liberia Immigration Service.
